# Vilas Hegde

> Senior Application Engineer at Okta. I build integrations, identity systems and GenAI workflows at Okta. I like to explore, solve problems, dive deep into technologies.

Ordinary person living best days of his life.

## How I think
- Do it by hand once, automate it the second time. If a task comes back, it gets a script. The first time teaches me what the script should do.
- Plan for the bad day. I design for the user who is offline, the retry that arrives twice and the server that dies mid-request.
- Measure before arguing. A graph ends most debates faster than an opinion does.
- Write it down before building it. A one-page design doc saves a week of rework and lets others build without waiting on me.
- Unblock people first. My own task can wait an hour. A teammate stuck for a day costs more.

## Now
- Architecture and GenAI integrations at Okta
- Automated development pipelines that speed up R&D
- Spend quality time

## Featured projects
- [chat-backend](https://github.com/vilasrhegde/WhatsApp): Chat backend for 10 million connections: stateless WebSocket gateways, Kafka fan-out and end-to-end encryption. (Kafka, Redis, Cassandra)
- [traffic-jam](https://github.com/vilasrhegde/The-Traffic-Jam): An observability lab: watch a service bend under load in one Docker Compose command. (Nginx, Prometheus, Grafana, k6)
- [job-hunter](https://github.com/vilasrhegde/job-hunter): Ranks open roles at 40+ companies by skill match. No LLM, just honest scoring. (Python, scraping)
- [gdp-prediction](https://github.com/vilasrhegde/GDP-Analysis-and-Prediction): Predicts the GDP of 227 countries and suggests what would grow it. (Python, Streamlit, Plotly)
